findings.detail: Line-ending reproducibility gap (per amendment 2): the implementer repo's tracked files are stored LF but a default Windows checkout (core.autocrlf=true) converts them to CRLF, changing sha256 vs the frozen LF manifest hashes. Handled by cloning with git -c core.autocrlf=false; verified 0 CRLF pairs and manifest-matching hashes in the clean checkout. This is the documented reason for the --mtime off clean-checkout mode and the reviewer's clone procedure.

Frozen inputs not fully committed / worktree dirty (per amendment 2): audit_review/README.md, 2026-08-13_three_repo_completion_rebaseline_plan/, 2026-08-13_zijin_data_lake_remediation_plan/, 2026-08-12_zijin_skill_run_audit/, assurance/runs/ are untracked, and tracked old-FCAP files (findings/progress/task_plan/work_unit_registry.md) were modified in the worktree by the planning program without being committed. A clean git clone therefore cannot reproduce the frozen input bytes. Handled by deleting clone's audit_review and copying the whole directory from the implementer worktree (145 files, hash-identical, mtimes preserved). This is a successor clue for CA-002/CA-004 (commit the frozen inputs or formalize the copy step), NOT a CA-001 failure.

mtime is not reproducible by any git checkout: --mtime off clean-checkout mode (commit 4d629b9) skips mtime equality while still enforcing hash+size. Verified: manifest-verify --mtime off prints the dedicated message and rc=0; strict mode stayed green in this clone only because the copy preserved mtimes. Real control-plane default remains strict; off is only for clean-checkout replay, by design — not judged changes_required.

RED evidence files (receipts/CA-001/red/p1_out.txt etc.) are committed LF but RED.md records sha256 of the CRLF worktree bytes (7ffcef26... = sha of LF->CRLF converted bytes; size 2332->2464). Suggest recording hashes over the committed LF bytes in future receipts.
